scope: Current GraphAnalysisRuntime TAO cycle; static code review, prior browser evidence, new scripted-model fault injection. No production code/config/server changes and no new provider calls.
verdict: A real tool/observation loop exists, with structural verification and bounded repair. It is not a sufficiently verified general autonomous analysis loop: custom Python mathematical intent can falsely complete.

cycle.details: LLM intent and population/semantic roles, structured tasks, verified/remaining work; controller reuse/fallback may skip another model call
LangChain create_agent tool loop, real registered contracts, preflight, goal/scope admission, executor/ledger guards
ToolMessages and receipts update typed evidence, dataset lineage, failed signatures and plan status; preserved transcript/checkpoint
Missing evidence/errors feed another model call or bounded grounded local path; semantic postconditions for custom computations are absent

findings.title: A successful Python execution can complete the wrong requested calculation
findings.verified: Reproduced using actual GraphAnalysisRuntime and worker with a scripted faulty model
findings.trigger: User requests a named two-row rolling mean; model emits result=df.copy()
findings.actual: answered/complete without rolling_mean column; valid comparison computation also answered and matches independent [1.5,2.5,3.5] oracle
findings.cause: Receipt admission validates source/handle/parent/code hash/input digest but no structured task-specific mathematical/output postcondition
findings.required_fix: Define per-task input/output grain, ordering, output columns and computation parameters; verify result invariants with independent tool/statistical checks, return semantic_mismatch observation and replan rather than mark completion. LLM review can assist but cannot be sole correctness evidence.

findings.title: Persistent plan is shared-scope output obligations, not a general independent task DAG
findings.cause: All task scopes copied from current goal; initial dependencies empty; completion by capability; duplicate capabilities rejected
findings.impact: Multiple differently filtered outputs of the same capability cannot be represented as separate executable obligations
findings.required_fix: Task IDs with task-specific source/scope/options/expected result, explicit dependencies and per-task validated receipts; versioned replan preserves completed tasks

findings.title: Stalled-discovery repair prompt contradicts automatic SQL policy
findings.verified: Unconditional static instruction; no new actual unauthorized SQL/approval UI reproduction
findings.actual_instruction: Any remote SQL still needs exact-query approval.
findings.cause: Recovery text is fixed even when runtime automatic reads are enabled; runtime.py dynamic policy says no approval waits
findings.required_fix: Single policy-derived instruction used by every normal, compact and repair prompt; cross-check automatic/manual policy and stalled recovery tests

findings.title: Cycle responsibilities remain concentrated in an oversized recovery module
findings.impact: Intent binding, evidence collection, local planning, action admission, repair and final rendering interact in one mutable recovery structure
findings.required_fix: Separate goal/task state, observation/evidence, recovery strategy and completion verification modules; preserve typed transitions and existing regression journeys

recommended_cycle: Interpret request and retain confirmed context
Create task contract and expected observable postconditions
Select an action from actual tool contracts and execution/resource policy
Execute and record tool observation with call/task IDs
Complete verified task or diagnose semantic/input/provider/resource failure
Replan only missing task without changing authorized population or replacing original data
evaluation_requirements: False-success injection: df.copy() or wrong window must fail verification despite valid code/lineage
Valid two-row mean completes and has exact independent values; recover wrong code without source reload
Different-scope repeated capability tasks retain separate task receipts and survive restart
Automatic/manual policy plus stalled discovery must never emit contradictory approval instructions
Failed alternative preserves filters, original digest and verified preceding outputs; repeated identical failures bounded
